Claim_or_Phenomenon: Basin Ipp-J Post-2002 Acceleration & Negative Mass Balance
Observational_Evidence: Reconstructed loss jumped from -3.21 km3/yr (1995–2001) to -21.80 km3/yr (2002–2014) and -21.36 km3/yr (2016–2024). ERS/Envisat/CryoSat-2 and Sentinel-1 show permanent tributary thinning and acceleration.
Model_Residual_Trajectory: Positive bias (+7.36 to +8.54 km3/yr) in all 9 test years. Accumulated +52 to +77 km3 under-prediction drift.
Causal_Attribution_Assessment: Established by glaciological literature (Scambos et al. 2004; Rignot et al. 2004; Berthier et al. 2012). Removal of Larsen B buttressing caused 2–8x speedup.
Missing_Physical_State_Variables: Ice shelf buttressing factor (theta_buttress), ice shelf frontal extent (km2), grounding line position migration (dx_GL), calving front back-stress tensor.

Claim_or_Phenomenon: Palmer Land (Hp-I) Test Period Deceleration / Accumulation Surge
Observational_Evidence: Observed volume loss in Hp-I attenuated to -10.88 km3/yr during 2016–2024 (compared to historical mean of -15.81 km3/yr). Driven by high snowfall accumulation years (e.g. 2016, 2019, 2022).
Model_Residual_Trajectory: Negative bias (-7.53 km3/yr for Bayesian Ridge Weighted). Over-predicted ice loss by 67.74 km3 over 9 years.
Causal_Attribution_Assessment: Established by RACMO2.4p1 atmospheric reanalysis and CryoSat-2 / ICESat-2 surface elevation gains.
Missing_Physical_State_Variables: Contemporaneous precipitation / accumulation anomalies (models only had access to lag-1 SMB, meaning they missed in-year snowfall surges).

Claim_or_Phenomenon: Failure of Statistical ML to Outperform Historical Mean Baseline
Observational_Evidence: Historical Mean achieved RMSE = 14.690 km3/yr vs 15.355 km3/yr for Bayesian Ridge Weighted. Paired t-test confirmed Historical Mean is superior to unweighted linear/GPR models (p < 0.01).
Model_Residual_Trajectory: ML models added variance without capturing interannual dynamic signal beyond the basin mean.
Causal_Attribution_Assessment: Plausible physical and statistical causation: Small sample size (N=108 training), high observation noise (+/- 7 to 20 km3/yr), and lack of contemporaneous forcing variables.
Missing_Physical_State_Variables: In-year weather anomalies, dynamic ice thickness changes, bedrock geometry pinning points.

Claim_or_Phenomenon: Compensating Cross-Basin Bias Cancellation on Domain A
Observational_Evidence: Domain A endpoint drift for Historical Mean is only +3.98 km3 (97.8% captured) because Hp-I drift (-44.37 km3) and I-Ipp drift (-4.79 km3) cancel out Ipp-J drift (+53.14 km3).
Causal_Attribution_Assessment: Coincidental cancellation between climatological under-prediction in Graham Land East and over-prediction in Palmer Land. Must not be interpreted as skilled whole-peninsula modeling.
Missing_Physical_State_Variables: Basin-specific dynamical coupling; independent regional mass balance controls.
